A tour of the Agano region countryside where you'll see, hear, and taste the seasons. Konjac plants take about 3 years to grow.

【Fee】Adults ¥4,000 | Elementary school children ¥3,000 | Preschoolers ¥1,500 (includes guide, insurance, lunch, etc.)

【Capacity】3 groups (2–4 people per group)

【Guide】Taira Chestnut Garden staff

【What to bring】Drinks, apron, head covering, towel, mask

【More info】Taira Chestnut Garden website https://tairakurien.com/
location: 集合 たいら栗園（西武池袋線「東吾野駅」下車徒歩15分）
summary: Experience the countryside with all five senses—try making homemade konjac!!!
